Chapter 1335 - 16: The Advent Of The Time Loop

Chapter 1335: Chapter 16: The Advent of the Time Loop

Two thousand years of slumber, Lin Yuan’s mind and will relaxing unprecedentedly, spreading freely.

Lin Yuan exerted no suppression or control, allowing this dispersion to proceed.

A thread of mind will drifted for an unknown duration, seemingly entering a certain layer of dream territory.

Arriving in an incredibly majestic and grand palace.

The palace was infinitely tall and grand, its tiers of stairs leading to an unknown destination.

"Here..."

This thread of Lin Yuan’s mind will was devoid of thoughts or questions, devoid of any doubts or concerns.

Instinctively, it simply followed the endless staircase, ascending step by step.

Unknown how much time had passed.

Finally reaching the end of the stairs.

Behold, a grand and majestic luminous gate stood there, its existence seemingly the source of everything, silently influencing timelines, dimensional realms, and myriad beings.

And at the threshold of the luminous gate, a blurred figure leaned against it.

The blurred figure’s visage indiscernible, Lin Yuan could only faintly make out the figure supporting its chin with the right hand, eyes closed, as if asleep.

It seemed to lean against that incredibly majestic luminous gate, yet the aura it faintly emanated surpassed the gate itself, the slight fluctuation of its breath sweeping through countless timelines, universal wonders, and endless dimensional planes birthed within its breath.

Boom!

The next moment.

Lin Yuan awoke.

"Hm?"

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly surprised.

"That dream?"

Two thousand years of sleep, Lin Yuan’s mind will infinitely dispersed, resulted in many ridiculously absurd dreams.

Yet this experience within an endlessly tall palace, and that towering, luminous gate, the blurred figure leaning against it uneasily hit Lin Yuan with significant impact.

"Is it a delusional dream, or..."

Lin Yuan felt a bit uncertain and wondered whether this dream was true or false, though the majestic luminous gate bore some likeness to the Myriad Realms Gate deep in his mind.

"Was it the Myriad Realms Gate affecting me?"

Lin Yuan contemplated, vaguely sensing this dream was far from simple, potentially containing some hint that the blurred figure leaning against the majestic luminous gate might be the previous master of the Myriad Realms Gate?

"Could it possibly be just a simple dream?"

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, though he acknowledged the dream, he didn’t dwell too much on it.

He let go completely of the dreams his mind will experienced, which were incredibly absurd, including countless fantasies.

If not for this dream’s luminous gate bearing some semblance to the Myriad Realms Gate in his mind, Lin Yuan wouldn’t have cared.

It’s merely a dream after all.

"Time to strive for the thirteen-stage breakthrough."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts.

After completely sleeping for two thousand years, Lin Yuan felt in an unprecedentedly good state.

This ’good’ wasn’t an invigorated state, but rather a satisfaction of a different sort.

Like someone who had starved for long suddenly enjoying a feast.

"Let’s bid farewell first."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts moved slightly.

This time with the thirteen-stage breakthrough, who knows how long it would take.

In the numerous future timelines, Lin Yuan’s ultimate breakthrough during the time cycle remained uncertain.

It could be a few hundred years, or it might span across thousands of years.

If calculated in thousands of years, he indeed should bid farewell to his family and friends before attempting the breakthrough.

Since humanity has only spanned a few thousand years transitioning from their native universe till now.

Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Nine Xuanyuan Supreme beings from the homeland universe period appeared together.

"Galaxy you?"

Xuanyuan Supreme Xia Qin observed the figure standing not far off.

"I’ve already decided to immediately attempt the thirteen-stage breakthrough."

Lin Yuan spoke, looking at Xia Qin and the other nine Supremes.

"Attempt the thirteen-stage breakthrough?"

Xuanyuan Supreme Xia Qin’s expression subtly shifted.

Though recently, a time lifeform appeared in the Chaos Void.

That doesn’t elevate the probability of crossing into the thirteen-stage.

On the contrary, the likelihood of achieving thirteen-stage in the Chaos Realm had always been slim.

Even though Lin Yuan had constantly brought countless miracles, Xuanyuan Supreme Xia Qin still couldn’t shake the worry from his heart.

"Could you delay the attempt?"

Xuanyuan Supreme was equally concerned, feeling that delaying the attempt might allow for further accumulation, augmenting the final assurance.

"Time matters not, early or late."

Lin Yuan shook his head.

He’s reached the peak in every aspect now.

Even waiting millions of years, his strength wouldn’t witness a qualitative change.

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s probability of crossing into the thirteen-stage was still absolutely certain.

"Since you, Galaxy, have decided, proceed with the attempt then."

Xuanyuan Supreme Xia Qin steadied himself and spoke.

"Barring unexpected events, within a span of thousands of years, I will step into the thirteen-stage." Lin Yuan spoke calmly as he eyed the nine Supremes.

"But if an unexpected event arises, and I don’t appear after more than ten thousand years, human civilization should implement the ultimate plan." Lin Yuan stated.

Currently, all future timelines he observed led to the thirteen-stage.

Yet the worst scenario must be prepared for, since what Lin Yuan observed couldn’t reflect all timelines, making direct determination of becoming a time lifeform uncertain.

Human civilization’s ultimate plan would hinge upon Lin Yuan’s failure in the thirteen-stage breakthrough, resulting in being trapped in time cycle.

Then human civilization would maintain low profile, consolidate strength, supported by thirty-three Postnatal Universes as the ultimate foundation, ensuring prosperous future for civilization.

"Alright..."

Xuanyuan Supreme and other nine Supremes nodded in silence.

...

Homeland universe.

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s avatar sat cross-legged, opened his eyes.

"Master." The six-armed figure of the Secret Realm Spirit promptly looked at Lin Yuan.

"This universe hasn’t entered rebirth, hasn’t yet evolved myriad beings." The six-armed figure instantly remarked.

He assumed Lin Yuan intended to observe the evolution of principles and paths as the natural universe transitioned from destruction to rebirth.

"I know."

Lin Yuan glanced outside the secret realm, "It will enter rebirth in thirty-six million years, and thirteen hundred and sixty million years later, the first being will come into existence."

"Ah?"

The six-armed silhouette of the Secret Realm Spirit blinked upon hearing this.

He had experienced the great cosmic destructions time and again, and he knew that the time of cosmic destruction and rebirth was essentially uncertain, depending on various influences.

Especially when this universe was prematurely destroyed due to the clash of two Chaos Great Saints, making it even more difficult to determine when a new birth would occur.

Yet Lin Yuan not only stated the time of new birth but also confirmed the time of the first lifeform’s emergence.

How is this possible?

The six-armed silhouette of the Secret Realm Spirit felt mystified in his heart but dared not ask more.

"I should leave now."

This avatar of Lin Yuan stood up.

"Leave?"

The six-armed silhouette was even more puzzled.

This avatar in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could serve as a life-saving measure, so why leave?

"I’m about to attempt the Thirteenth Layer, and all mental wills must return to the true self."

Lin Yuan rarely explained.

When making a complete breakthrough from the Twelfth to the Thirteenth Layer, it is best to gather all mental wills.

As for not gathering them? It doesn’t have much impact; the Moyu Tower Master also left a trace of mental will in the Demon Jade Space before attempting the Thirteenth Layer.

But the meaning isn’t very significant; just a trace of mental will can’t exert any strength, and it must forcibly fall into the time loop just after awakening.

"Attempt the Thirteenth Layer?"

The six-armed silhouette was somewhat stunned.

Attempt the Thirteenth Layer?

Lin Yuan?

Hasn’t Lin Yuan just left his home universe for long?

And he’s already attempting the Thirteenth Layer?

"If all goes well, you should be able to see your Majesty."

Lin Yuan smiled slightly and then dispersed this avatar.

With his current strength, the iron rule of natural universes forbidding the entry of foreign life is ineffective.

If Lin Yuan wants to enter a natural universe, he can enter.

...

One of the thirty-three Postnatal Universes.

On a planet filled with greenery.

Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong were vacationing here.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

"Xiaoyuan."

Lu Qiong immediately called out.

"It’s been a long time since you looked for us."

Lu Qiong said somewhat accusingly.

"Yes, we haven’t even seen you in the Virtual World."

Lin Shoucheng added beside her.

"I’ve been in seclusion for two thousand years," Lin Yuan said with a smile.

In these two thousand years of deep sleep, he contacted no one, not even family.

"How have you been?"

Lin Yuan casually asked.

"Not bad, but a bit dull, just playing around every day..." Lin Shoucheng said.

"This universe is too large," Lu Qiong also said.

"If you feel bored, contact Little Spirit; she’ll introduce you to more fun things."

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

Little Spirit, that is the Spirit of this Postnatal Universe.

The thirty-three Postnatal Universes, each vast, equivalent to the size of thousands upon tens of thousands of Void Domains.

Moreover, they nurture countless uniquely characteristic planets; even if Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong played until the Chaos Void’s great destruction, they wouldn’t encounter the same planet twice.

Besides various planets, there are many entertainment areas, making this Postnatal Universe a place where countless lives are born, prepared specifically for Lin Yuan’s family.

"After this, I need to enter seclusion again; not sure how long it will be."

Lin Yuan said.

"No problem, Xiaoyuan, your cultivation is most important."

Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong immediately said, knowing that at Lin Yuan’s level, a seclusion of a million or ten million years is extremely normal.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He continued chatting with his parents for a while.

Lin Yuan then dispersed this avatar.

All mental wills dispersed throughout the Chaos Void would return to the true self.

The two true selves from the first and second Source Worlds also completely gathered many avatars.

Although the three true selves are independent causally, this cannot be hidden from the supreme Dao rules; once choosing to attempt the Thirteenth Layer, all true selves would fall into the time loop.

Only by fully breaking through the time loop can they return.

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan stepped out, leaving the Galaxy Chaos Continent, standing in a desolate void somewhere.

"Let’s begin."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm as he released the suppression on his own life’s essence.

And losing Lin Yuan’s suppression, his life’s essence began naturally elevating, raising to a certain extent, and threads of time power started condensing, continuously surrounding Lin Yuan.

A vast amount of time power continuously gathered.

Until—

The time loop belonging to Lin Yuan.

Descended!
